title: BridgeRepaired
description: A down bridge was repaired to full HP (CONTRACTS 6; STATE-MACHINES 4.3; NX-373 part 2): its road edge is back for path planning. Once per down cycle; a damaged bridge that was never down emits nothing as it is repaired.

by_id.description: The lowest-id unit parked at the bridge's repair stop on the tick it reached full HP; null for a hidden actor in a filtered view.
